title: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Gaza:
text:
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Gaza:"

"We see that Netanyahu and his team are increasingly escalating policies that trample on human dignity and are adopting an attitude that is virtually provoking the entire international community."

"The policies pursued by Netanyahu and his associates have become not merely an issue concerning Gaza, the Middle East, or the region, but a security problem that concerns the entire international community."
